topic: Advanced Use of Default Template Parameters in C++ (as an analogy for C techniques)
explanation: While C does not support templates directly, this concept illustrates advanced techniques related to default parameters and flexible code design, which can be paralleled in C through complex macro patterns, function overloading via function pointers, or conditional compilation. Understanding default template parameters in C++ helps inform how to implement similar advanced abstraction and customization mechanisms in C, such as using macros or function pointers for flexible, reusable code structures in high-performance or system-level programming.
keywords: Default template parameters, Template default arguments, C++ template customization, Default type parameters
